The '''Sanctum Sanctorum''' was the workshop of [[Min Erethen]] a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] working for [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It was located inside of the ''[[Bhishana Bhaga]]'' when it crashed on [[Krykas V]]. The Sanctum Sanctorum was the only thing that kept Min Erenthen from dying during the crash. The Sanctum Sanctorum was an outdated [[A4 Juggernaut]] that was modified by Erethen as a mobile workshop and escape vehicle. While on Krykas V the Sanctum Sanctorum had [[polarizing field generator]]s to allow electronic equipment to be used in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Krykas V within around fifty meters of the vehicle. After Min Erathen was rescued by a group of mercenaries it was unknown whether it was taken off Krykas V or destroyed by Min Erethen to keep it out of the hands of others.
